message.content:
A cell that contains more than one nucleus is called a **multinucleated cell**.  
In many organisms, such cells form a **syncytium**, which is a single cell membrane surrounding several nuclei.  

Examples of multinucleated cells include:

| Cell type | Organism | Function |
|-----------|----------|----------|
| Skeletal muscle fibers | Humans | Contractile muscle tissue |
| Osteoclasts | Humans | Bone resorption |
| Myoblasts (fused) | Humans | Muscle development |
| Certain fungal hyphae | Fungi | Growth and nutrient absorption |

These cells arise either through the fusion of individual cells or by failure of cytokinesis during cell division.
